import urllib.request
import json
import urllib.parse

parts = [
    "C1=CC(=CC=C1C(=O)NC(CC(=O)O)C(=O)O)NCC2=CC3=C(C=C2)N=C(N=C3N)N", # CID 29334
    "O=C(O)CC(NC(=O)C1=CC=C(NCC2=CC=CC=C2)C=C1)C(=O)O", # without quinazoline, just benzylamine
    "O=C(O)CC(NC(=O)C1=CC=CC=C1)C(=O)O", # N-benzoyl-aspartic acid
    "NC(CC(=O)O)C(=O)O", # aspartic acid
    "C1=CC(=CC=C1C(=O)O)NCC2=CC3=C(C=C2)N=C(N=C3N)N", # without aspartic acid
    "C1=CC(=CC=C1)NCC2=CC3=C(C=C2)N=C(N=C3N)N", # N-(quinazolin-6-ylmethyl)aniline
]

for smi in parts:
    encoded = urllib.parse.quote(smi)
    url = f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/smiles/{encoded}/property/HBondDonorCount,HBondAcceptorCount/JSON"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
            print(f"{smi} -> HBD: {data['PropertyTable']['Properties'][0]['HBondDonorCount']}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"{smi} -> Error: {e}")
